title: Money conversion to minor units with currency precision rules
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag the quantize call as rounding that could hide excess precision. The precision check runs first and rejects any amount whose value would actually change under quantizing; quantize with an explicit ROUND_HALF_UP is used only to normalise exact values (including harmless trailing zeros), so nothing is silently rounded.
